heading: Bridal
blurb: Rani haars, temple sets, nath and maang tikka. The pieces a family remembers for generations.

heading: Polki & Kundan
blurb: Uncut diamonds and hand-set kundan with meenakari backs. Rajasthani craft, Ahmedabad finish.
intro: Polki and kundan are slow work. Each stone is set in gold foil by hand and the back is enamelled by a second artisan. Expect a few weeks, and a piece that looks different from every angle.
